description: Full Reputa scoring for a wallet: Security, Risk and Reputation scores with reason codes, plus profile traits (e.g. HODLer, DeFi-native, governance, staker, Safe/smart-account - or an entity type like CEX/DEX/bridge/DAO) and a staking & governance breakdown. Paid per-use via x402 (USDC on Polygon); auto-pays if REPUTA_PAYER_PRIVATE_KEY is set, otherwise returns the x402 payment requirements. Ethereum mainnet.
name: reputa_wallet_scores
